title: XP Tablets
description: Store XP in tablets, retrieve it from tablets, use it for repairing tools/armour in an anvil.
body:
# XP Tablets

A simple mod that lets you store your experience points in portable items.

It features five tiers of tablets: Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite. Each with increasing storage space and faster transfer speeds.

## How it works:
Hold the tablet in your hand and hold right-click to drain your XP into the tablet.
Hold the tablet and hold crouch + right-click to drain the tablet back into you.

## What can you do with them?
- Fix your gear in an anvil, the tablet's stored XP will be used for the repair at a 1:2 ratio. You'll still need 1 XP on yourself to complete the repair. You'll get the tablet back with any leftover XP.
 
- Give your XP to someone else, just toss them a tablet full of XP!
## Tiers
- Copper: Holds 160 XP (10 levels)
- Iron: Holds 550 XP (20 levels)
- Gold: Holds 1395 XP (30 levels)
- Diamond: Holds 2920 XP (40 levels)
- Netherite: Holds 5345 XP (50 levels)
